defects.title: Legacy Train A-D and Hardcoded 4-Train Topology
defects.impact: Precludes universal multi-plant portability. Fails on plants with 2, 3, 5, 6, or 7 trains.
defects.resolution: Migrate all internal structures and UI to canonical T01-T07 with dynamic 1-7 train instantiation.

defects.title: Hardcoded Membrane Area (4800 m² per train / 19200 m² plant total)
defects.impact: Causes dangerous flux errors on plants with different membrane cassette densities or module models.
defects.resolution: Calculate Active Membrane Area dynamically from online configured trains: Σ Membrane_Area(Txx).

defects.title: Fake Excel Parity Assertions & Hardcoded Numeric Comparisons
defects.impact: Masks mathematical divergence between Excel formulas and Python engine.
defects.resolution: Implement real three-way execution: recalculate Excel, extract calculated cell values, compare with Python and TypeScript.

defects.title: Stubbed Telemetry Ingestion (read_excel_telemetry uses DEFAULT_TELEMETRY)
defects.impact: Offline Excel telemetry cannot actually feed real-time analytical pipeline.
defects.resolution: Parse live OpenXML/openpyxl cells from input sheets and construct canonical runtime telemetry.

defects.title: Missing Plant Configuration Layer (Single Source of Truth)
defects.impact: Plant design values and limits are scattered across python/mbr_engine/config.py, JSON files, and TS benchmarks.
defects.resolution: Create unified 20_Plant_Configuration schema with parameter provenance, verification status, and limits.

defects.title: Lack of Train Operating Status Filtering in Plant Calculations
defects.impact: Offline or maintenance trains contaminate active flux, TMP, and peer calculations.
defects.resolution: Enforce: Train active only when Installed=TRUE, Operating_Status=ONLINE, and Data_Quality=VALID.

defects.title: Viscosity Model Correlation Disagreement (Exponential vs Polynomial)
defects.impact: Small mathematical discrepancy between Python Darcy resistance and TypeScript Darcy resistance.
defects.resolution: Standardize on single validated Poiseuille/IAPWS model across Excel, Python, and TypeScript.

defects.title: Temperature Correction Factor (TCF) Definition Discrepancy
defects.impact: TypeScript uses Arrhenius theta^(20-T) with theta=1.025, while Python uses viscosity ratio mu(20)/mu(T).
defects.resolution: Standardize TCF to viscosity ratio mu(20)/mu(T) matching Darcy membrane physics.

defects.title: Clean Membrane Resistance Rm Discrepancy (1.497e12 vs 1.5076e12 m^-1)
defects.impact: Clean water baseline resistance drift between modules.
defects.resolution: Set Rm from authoritative plant configuration with provenance status OEM_VERIFIED or NOT_CALIBRATED.

defects.title: Scattered and Stale Software Version Metadata
defects.impact: Inconsistent telemetry payloads (0.8.0, 0.7.0, 1.0.0, Stage 10) causes telemetry rejection.
defects.resolution: Establish single authoritative version constant: v1.1.0.

defects.title: Tag Names Bound Directly to Unit 77 SCADA Conventions
defects.impact: Prevents deploying at Uzbekistan GTL or other facilities without recoding tag names.
defects.resolution: Implement Tag Mapping layer mapping plant-specific tags to canonical Txx.TMP, Txx.FLOW, etc.

defects.title: Hardcoded 'Unit 77' Strings in UI and Report Templates
defects.impact: Cosmetic assumption that the application is only for Unit 77.
defects.resolution: Drive plant name dynamically from Plant Configuration.

defects.title: Missing Configuration Completeness Score & Real Plant Mode Validator
defects.impact: Operators might run in Real Plant Mode without mandatory parameters configured.
defects.resolution: Implement Configuration Completeness Score (0-100%) and block calculations when required parameters missing.

defects.title: Fixed 4-Train Headers in Excel Sheet Layouts
defects.impact: Excel sheet templates display static Train A, B, C, D columns.
defects.resolution: Upgrade sheet templates to dynamic T01-T07 layout driven by Plant Configuration.
